content: Hahoi Naamath tami Zophar ni a pathung teh,

content.text: Hatdawkvah ka pouk lawi, pathung nahane na poe,
bangkongtetpawiteh, ka thung e lungreithai kecu dawk doeh.
Tounnae ni na yue e hah ka thai toe.
Ka muitha ni thaipanueknae hoi pathungnae na sak pouh.
Ayan hoi talaivan
tami ao totouh hoi,
tamikathoutnaw tânae tueng teh a duem.
Cathut bang lah kangaihoehnaw e lunghawinae teh,
dawngdengca doeh tie hah na panuek awh hoeh maw.
A kâoupnae hah kalvan totouh a pha teh,
a lû ni tâmai hah ka phat nakunghai,
A payungpaei patetlah a yungyoe kahmat vaiteh,
ahni kahmawtnaw pueng ni na maw ao telah ati awh han.
Mang patetlah yout kahmat vaiteh, hmawt mahoeh toe.
Karum e mang patetlah yout kahma e patetlah ao han.
Ahni kahmawt e mit ni vah hmawt mahoeh toe.
Hoeh pawiteh, hmuen ni hai kuen mahoeh toe.
A canaw ni tami ka roedeng minhmai kahawi hah tawng awh vaiteh,
a kut hoi hnopai hah bout a bankhai han.
A hrunaw teh nawcanae thaonae hoi akawi han.
Hateiteh, vaiphu dawk a ikhai han.
A pahni dawk kahawihoehe a radip.
A lai rahim vah a hro nakunghai,
Pasoung laipalah a pâkuem.
A kâko dawkvah a hro nakunghai,
A rawca teh, a vonthung vah a ui vaiteh,
tahrunsue lah a kangcoung han.
A tawnta e hnopai hah padoun vaiteh bout a palo han.
Cathut ni a von thung hoi a tâkhawng pouh.
Tahrun sue hah a pahap teh,
tahrun lai ni a ma a thei han.
Kalawng e palang, khoitui hoi maito sanutui kamkak vaiteh,
ka lawng e hmawt mahoeh.
A tawk e thaw ni a coung sak han ei,
von paha nahanelah hno mahoeh.
Karoenaw hah a ceitakhai hoi, a coungroe teh,
Ama ni a sak hoeh e im hah a lawp.
A lung thung hoi roumnae hah a panue hoeh dawk.
A ngai e hno buet touh boehai cawi mahoeh.
A ca hanelah a pek e banghai awm hoeh.
Hatdawkvah a nawmnae ni kasaw awm mahoeh.
A nawm lahun nah kângairu vaiteh,
ama taranlahoi kângairu patawpoung e kut dawk a pha han.
A von a paha lahun nah Cathut ni
a lungkhueknae hmai hah ahni koe a tha poeh han.
A ca lahun nah a lathueng vah lungkhueknae kho a rak pouh han.
Sum e senehmaica teh, a yawng takhai han ei,
rahumpala ni pawkkayawng lah a ka awh han.
Pala teh a phawk, a tak dawk hoi a tâco pouh.
Loukloukkaang e a hmo hah hmue thung hoi a tâco.
Takikatho poung e a lathueng vah a pha.
Runae pueng teh ama hanelah pâtung lah ao.
Tami ni patawi hoeh e hmai ni be a kak vaiteh,
a im dawk kaawm e pueng ama hoi a kak han.
Kalvannaw ni a payonnae hah a pâpho han,
talai ni ama hah a taran han.
A im e hnopainaw hah be kahmat vaiteh,
a lungkhueknae hnin dawk hnokahawinaw
hah tui patetlah a lawng han.
Hetheteh Cathut koehoi tamikathoutnaw ni a coe hanelah ao.
Cathut ni a coe hane râw a pouk pouh e doeh telah a ti.
